design: Exploratory specification after exposure to existing records; prospective diagnostic observations, without an unseen holdout or confirmatory registration

status_definitions.PRESENT_IN_EDITION: A relation is explicitly transcribed/encoded in an inspected electronic edition; physical reading/function/date may still need verification
status_definitions.COMPATIBLE: Observation permits a branch without discriminating it
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Required relation is absent from the available record or unresolved by damage, reading or context
status_definitions.CONTRADICTED: Positive source evidence conflicts with the exact scoped claim; none assigned to Herodium roles

gates.question: Are mem/lamed-he numerals in these particular labels?
gates.reason: Naveh offers the numerical reading tentatively; the preceding session recovered the publication, without independently certifying damaged strokes or number function.

gates.question: Is the number explicitly linked to an ancient fixed location?
gates.reason: No numbered feature or associated mapping is supplied by the inspected record.

gates.question: Is the number explicitly assigned as the identifier of a portable referent?
gates.reason: Hidden-object sense is permitted, but object identity versus amount remains unresolved.

gates.question: Does complete syntax make the numeral a count of named objects?
gates.reason: Restoration/lacuna prevents a complete count-role argument.

gates.question: Does surviving text independently link the number to a measurement unit?
gates.reason: No positive unit link is verified; damaged/missing text prevents treating absence as contradiction.

gates.question: Does complete text give a spatial/retrieval relation?
gates.reason: Interpretive place translation and earth qualification alone do not supply an explicit instruction.

branches.claim: The proposed numeral identifies a particular storage or concealment place.
branches.prediction: An independently interpreted associated register or fixed place label maps the number to a location, while separately expressing any quantities.
branches.success: Same number is explicitly assigned to a fixed place in an associated record with independently established contextual association.
branches.failure: A complete associated record expressly assigns the same label's numeral to a measured amount or unique portable object, contradicting this label's place-number role.
branches.limit: Several jars bearing one number could mark a batch, owner, amount, quality or place; repetition alone is non-discriminating.

branches.claim: The proposed numeral identifies a portable hidden object, jar, lot or parcel.
branches.prediction: A complete associated record distinguishes the numbered portable referent from its location and its quantity.
branches.success: Contextually associated text explicitly identifies the numbered object/lot and separately records its destination or quantity.
branches.failure: Contextually associated text explicitly uses this numeral as a fixed-place identifier or measured amount, incompatible with a portable identifier.
branches.limit: A number written on a jar does not select this role; a jar can carry a place label or commodity amount.

branches.claim: The proposed numeral counts concealed objects or storage units.
branches.prediction: A complete grammatical count phrase or associated manifest links the numeral to counted units.
branches.success: Unrestored count syntax identifies what is counted; an associated deposit count may be a secondary check if completeness is established.
branches.failure: Complete associated text expressly assigns this numeral to an identifier or a measurement unit rather than a count.
branches.limit: Present fragment count or modern catalogue numbering cannot test an original count.

branches.claim: The proposed numeral expresses an amount of the stored contents.
branches.prediction: A unit or explicit commodity-measure relation links the numeral to contents in complete text.
branches.success: A preserved unit-quantity link or explicit measurement statement establishes the numeral's quantity role; commodity identity remains separate.
branches.failure: Complete associated text assigns this numeral to a place/object identifier or object count, incompatible with this quantity role.
branches.limit: Jar form, storeroom context or residue identity alone cannot assign a number's semantic role. Masada 595 demonstrates the kind of explicit unit relation sought.

branches.claim: The surviving labels form part of an instruction locating or retrieving something.
branches.prediction: Additional associated text explicitly relates a named object to a destination, path or retrieval act.
branches.success: Independently read, contextually associated instruction supplies that relation.
branches.failure: Complete recovered text supplies only a nominal label with no locative or retrieval relation; this rejects this explicit-instruction claim only.
branches.limit: A label may aid retrieval without being an instruction. Missing preceding text prevents an absence argument.

decision_rule: Each role requires all named gates; unknown gates yield 'not identifiable from available evidence'. Compatible observations never become a score total. Branches can coexist across records, and LOCATOR_MESSAGE can coexist with an identifier or quantity.
